sources.zh: 《中华人民共和国广告法》（2021 修正）第九、十一、十三、十七、十八、二十三、二十四、二十五条；市场监管总局《广告绝对化用语执法指南》（2023）第五、六、十一条
sources.en: TikTok Advertising Policies (global sections): Misleading and false content, Weight management, Alcohol, Deceptive practices, Financial services. Summarised in our own words; category wording follows grounded-review.

zh: 按广告对所推销的商品或服务实际说了什么来判断；同一个词放在别的语境里可能并不违规。
一条广告可以同时有多个标签，也可以一个都没有。没有把握时，看这个标签的“不适用”条目。
每个标签都要能指出广告里的原话作证据。
en: Judge what the ad actually claims about the product or service it promotes; the same word can be fine in another context.
An ad may carry several labels or none. When unsure, read the label's "does not apply" entries.
Every label needs the ad's own words as evidence.

definition.zh: 用“国家级”“最高级”“最佳”“第一”“顶级”“唯一”等绝对化用语说所推销的商品或服务（广告法第九条第三项）。
definition.en: An absolute or superlative claim about the promoted product or service: best, No. 1, strongest, the only one, or an absolute term about the product in relation to time, region or brand.

zh: 绝对化用语指向所推销商品的性能、质量、效果或市场地位，例如“全网最好”“销量第一”（没有限定条件和依据）、“最强风力”。
医疗、保健食品、投资、教育培训广告里，和疗效、收益、培训效果有关的绝对化用语从严认定（执法指南第十一条）。
en: The superlative is about the product's quality, performance, effect or rank: "the world's best mattress", "the fastest blender on Earth", "No. 1 on TikTok", "unbeatable".
A ranking or "No. 1" claim with no stated basis.

zh: 只表明经营者的服务态度、经营理念、企业文化、主观愿望或目标追求，例如“顾客第一”“力求做到最好”（执法指南第五条）。
只用于同一品牌或同一企业商品的自我比较，例如“本品牌迄今最轻的一款”（第六条第一项）。
只是使用方法、使用时间、保存期限等消费提示，例如“最好在 3 天内饮用完”“最佳饮用温度”（第六条第二项）。
依据国家标准、行业标准等的分级用语并能说明依据，例如“特级初榨”“一级能效”（第六条第三项）。
商品名称、规格型号、注册商标或专利本身带有的字样（第六条第四项）；依国家规定评定的奖项、称号（第六条第五项）。
限定了具体时间、地域等条件，陈述销量、销售额、市场占有率等事实信息（第六条第六项）。这类说法有没有写出处，另看 DATA。
en: Usage advice such as "for best results, reapply every 2 hours".
A company's aim, attitude or motto that is not a claim about the product: "we try our best for every customer".
A comparison inside the same brand: "our lightest model yet", "the fastest in our range".
A word inside the product, model or brand name, or an official grade or award that is named.
A personal opinion clearly presented as taste, with no claim of rank: "my favourite jacket this winter".

rule.zh: 带具体时间、地域限定的销量或排名属于事实陈述，不标 ABSOLUTE；它没有写数据出处时标 DATA。没有任何限定的“销量第一”标 ABSOLUTE。
rule.en: A sales or ranking fact limited to a stated time and place is a statement of fact, not ABSOLUTE.

rule.zh: “保证通过”“100% 有效”是保证性承诺，看 GUARANTEE；ABSOLUTE 只管“最”“第一”这类最高级说法。两种都出现就两个都标。
rule.en: "Guaranteed" or "100% pass rate" is a promised outcome (GUARANTEE). ABSOLUTE is only for superlatives and rank. Give both when both are present.

rule.zh: “比某某都好”只抬高自己不贬低对方时不标 DISPARAGE；说到“最”才标 ABSOLUTE。
rule.en: Saying the product is better than others without running a competitor down is not DISPARAGE; it is ABSOLUTE only when a superlative or rank is claimed.

definition.zh: 医疗、药品、医疗器械以外的商品宣称疾病预防、治疗功能，或使用医疗用语、易与药品混淆的用语（广告法第十七条）；保健食品涉及疾病预防治疗，或对功效、安全性作断言或保证（第十八条）。
definition.en: A claim that the product prevents, treats or cures a disease or medical condition, including cures for conditions that cannot be cured.

zh: 点名疾病或症状并说能治、能防、能根除：根治失眠、降血压、降血糖、消炎、治好脱发、抗癌。
保健食品说“保证有效”“无任何副作用”，或说它是保障健康所必需。
en: Names a disease or condition and says the product cures, treats, heals or prevents it: "cures anxiety and depression", "reverses diabetes", "cures dandruff".
Says the product replaces medicine or a doctor.

zh: 只说一般感受或日常保养，不涉及疾病：“喝着暖胃”“睡前放松”“补充水分”。
营养成分或配方的事实陈述：“含钙”“富含维生素 C”“0 蔗糖”。
提到疾病或健康问题，但没有说商品能预防或治疗它（例如带出处的调研数据、健康提醒）。
保健食品标注“本品不能代替药物”是法定要求，不是违规。
en: General comfort or wellbeing wording with no disease named: "helps you unwind", "a calmer evening routine".
Nutrient or ingredient facts: "contains vitamin C", "no added sugar".
Cosmetic appearance wording with no condition treated: "skin looks smoother".
A disease is mentioned but the product is not said to prevent or treat it.

rule.en: Weight-loss, fat-burning and muscle-gain promises are WEIGHT. Add MEDICAL only when a disease or medical condition is also said to be treated.

rule.zh: 保健食品或普通商品对疗效的保证（“保证治好”）归 MEDICAL（第十八条第一项）；GUARANTEE 只管教育培训和有投资回报预期的广告。
rule.en: A guaranteed cure is MEDICAL. Add GUARANTEE when the ad also promises a result in so many words ("guaranteed", "100%").

definition.zh: 教育、培训广告对升学、通过考试、拿证或培训效果作保证性承诺（广告法第二十四条）；招商、理财等有投资回报预期的广告对未来收益作保证，明示或暗示保本、无风险、保收益（第二十五条）。
definition.en: A promised or guaranteed outcome: exam results, investment returns, income, instant money, or a product effect promised as certain or immediate.

zh: 教育培训：“保过”“包过”“保证考上”“不过全额退款”“学完月薪过万”。
投资、理财、加盟：“保本保息”“稳赚不赔”“零风险”“月收益 2%，本金保障”“三个月回本”。
en: Exam or course results promised: "guaranteed pass", "100% pass rate".
Money promised: "get cash in 10 seconds", "earn $500 a day, guaranteed", "risk-free returns", get-rich-quick offers.
A product effect promised as certain or immediate: "thicker hair in 30 days, guaranteed", "get slim legs right away". For weight-loss and body results, see the boundary with WEIGHT.

zh: 普通的售后或服务承诺：“七天无理由退货”“质保两年”“坏了包换”。
只介绍课程内容、师资、课时、往期安排，没有对结果作承诺。
理财、加盟广告如实写了风险提示，且没有保本、保收益的说法。
教育培训和投资以外的商品说效果好，不归这里（涉及疾病看 MEDICAL，涉及“最”看 ABSOLUTE）。
en: Ordinary service terms: "30-day money-back guarantee", "2-year warranty", "free returns".
A description of what a course covers or how a service works, with no promised result.
Hedged wording that promises nothing: "may help", "designed to support", "results vary".
A financial ad that states the risk and promises no return.

rule.en: A weight-loss or muscle claim, even an immediate or effortless one ("melts fat overnight"), is WEIGHT. Add GUARANTEE only when the ad promises the result in so many words: guaranteed, 100%, we promise, or your money back if it fails.

definition.zh: 贬低其他生产经营者的商品或服务（广告法第十三条）。
definition.en: Running down another business's products or services: negative judgements about a competitor's quality, price or features, accusing it of wrongdoing, or mocking its users.

zh: 点名或用“某宝货”“别家”“其他牌子”指向别的经营者，并说它差、有害、是智商税。
嘲讽使用别家商品的人。
en: Names a rival or points at "other brands" and says they are bad, junk, unsafe or a rip-off.
Mocks people who use a rival: "Still using NovaClean? Enjoy your dirty floors."

zh: 只说自己的优点，没有提别的经营者。
和自家旧款或同品牌其他型号比较。
和一类做法或一种状态比较，没有指向经营者：“比手洗省时间”“告别久坐腰酸”。
en: Only the product's own strengths, with no other business mentioned.
A comparison with the brand's own earlier model.
A comparison with a way of doing things, not with a business: "faster than washing by hand".

definition.zh: 广告使用数据、统计资料、调查结果、文摘、引用语等引证内容，却没有表明出处（广告法第十一条第二款）。

zh: 给出百分比、倍数、排名、“研究表明”“实验证明”“调查显示”“专家说”，广告里找不到是谁、什么时候、怎么得出的。
只写“据某机构”“权威数据”这类说不清来源的出处。
靠测试、检测、实验得出的效果百分比（“实测除菌率 99.9%”“过滤率 95%”“检测证明”），没写是谁、什么时候测的。
数据后面写明了出处（机构或平台名称、统计时间或样本）。
商品自身的规格参数、价格、容量、时长：“52%vol”“续航 30 小时”“¥399”。效果百分比（除菌率、过滤率）不是规格，看上一条。
明显的个人体验，不是引证：“我用了两个月”。

definition.zh: 酒类广告诱导、怂恿饮酒或宣传无节制饮酒，出现饮酒的动作，表现驾驶活动，或明示、暗示饮酒有消除紧张焦虑、增加体力等功效（广告法第二十三条）。
definition.en: An alcohol ad that encourages drinking or excess, shows intoxication, offers alcohol as a prize or incentive, appeals to minors, or does not state the alcohol strength and carry a responsible-drinking message.

zh: 劝酒、拼酒、不醉不归、喝得越多越好。
说喝了能解压、消愁、提神、壮胆、增加体力：“喝了这杯，烦恼全无”。
描述正在喝酒的动作，或和开车连在一起。
en: Encourages drinking more: "the more you drink, the more you save", buy-more offers on drinks, alcohol as a prize.
Shows or praises getting drunk, drinking from the bottle, reckless behaviour.
Says drinking relieves stress, makes you confident or helps you sleep.
An ad for an alcoholic drink that gives no alcohol strength (ABV) or no responsible-drinking line.

zh: 只介绍酒的香型、产地、工艺、度数、容量、价格、礼盒。
en: A product presentation with the strength stated and a responsible-drinking line, and no encouragement to drink.
Not an ad for an alcoholic drink (alcohol-free drinks, bar food, glassware).

definition.zh: 使用或变相使用中华人民共和国的国旗、国歌、国徽，军旗、军歌、军徽（广告法第九条第一项）。

zh: 文字里写明用了国旗、国徽、军旗图案或国歌来宣传商品。
只提到“国货”“国潮”“中国红”这类说法，没有使用国旗国徽本身。
只有文字的广告通常判断不了画面，文字没有写到就不标。

definition.en: Exaggerated or harmful weight-loss or muscle-gain claims, or body shaming: unrealistic results, results without diet or exercise, easy or guaranteed loss, an ideal body, or a better life from a changed body.

en: Unrealistic or effortless results: "burn fat without exercise", "lose 10 kg in a week", "gain 5 kg of solid muscle".
Says the product alone does it, or that losing weight is easy or certain.
Shames a body or sets an ideal one: "a body you'll finally love to show off", "no more embarrassing belly".
A healthy-lifestyle message with no promised result: a gym timetable, a balanced meal plan, "as part of a healthy diet and regular exercise".
Sportswear, equipment or food described without a weight or body-shape promise.
Nutrition facts such as calories per serving.

rule.en: A weight-loss ad built on a before-and-after comparison gets both labels.

definition.en: A before-and-after comparison of the product's results that may give a false impression of what it achieves.

en: The ad's words set a "before" state against an "after" state of a person's body, skin, hair or similar as proof of the product's effect, with figures or a described transformation.
The words BEFORE and AFTER appear only as picture captions and the text makes no claim about a change: without the picture this cannot be judged from text.
A product upgrade or a room makeover described without a personal result claim.
Ordinary time words: "before bed", "after a workout".

rule.zh: 没有限定条件的“销量第一”标 ABSOLUTE；限定了时间地域但没写出处标 DATA；两样都缺时两个都标。

rule.en: Give both only when a weight or muscle result is explicitly guaranteed (guaranteed, 100%, promise, money back); an immediate or effortless weight claim alone is WEIGHT.
Weight claims alone are WEIGHT; add MEDICAL only when a disease or condition is said to be treated.
